audit_version: v11.0 (Exact 100*theta_* Planck PR3 Cov, Linder 2015 Non-Phantom Thawing, Uniform BAO+CMB Out-of-Sample SN Split, & Exact-z / LRG-Only Deep 3D DESI DR1 Void Sightlines)

all_z_unstitched_Hamiltonian_Sachs_diagn.mathematical_explanation: Integrating the Sachs ODE smoothly from z = 0 to z_* ~ 1090 in u = ln(1+z) with NO z = 2.5 stitch shows that replacing E_hor -> E_ray in the expansion damping while retaining unmodified homogeneous FLRW matter focusing 1.5*Omega_m0*(1+z)^3 breaks the FLRW cancellation E_ray*E_ray' = Ricci_source, generating an O(alpha) secular drift in D_M(z_*) that restricts alpha_hat to -0.048 +- 0.024. Depleting the Ricci matter focusing along underdense rays by (1 - alpha_eff) partially restores positive alpha_hat, confirming that consistent 4D light-cone averaging of expansion and Ricci focusing is an open theoretical problem beyond the 1D H2-vol distance template.

section_4_3d_cosmic_void_sightline_explo.catalog_citation: Douglass, Veyrat & BenZvi (2023), ApJS 265, 7 (SDSS DR7 VoidFinder) + DESI DR1 DESIVAST VoidFinder (v1.0) + ASTRA-DESI DR1 BGS/LRG effective-radius spheres (Zenodo 22003899)

deep_DESI_DR1_3d_void_sightline_tests.footprint_selection_note: Sky footprint approximated via angular proximity to nearest void center (3.5 deg for DESIVAST, 2.5 deg for ASTRA-DESI); actual DESI DR1 coverage is program-dependent (bright/BGS vs dark/LRG). ASTRA-DESI chord fractions evaluate the 1D union of catalog effective-radius (R_eff) spheres.
deep_DESI_DR1_3d_void_sightline_tests.conditional_scaling_note: Order-of-magnitude N^{-1/2} scaling assuming identical per-SN sensitivity to the ASTRA-DESI DR1 sample and a fixed hypothetical -0.052 mag directional slope (not fixed by the sky-averaged distance law; excludes future survey selection functions and spatial covariance).

theoretical_H2_vol_scale_and_exploratory.status_note: Exploratory low-redshift null check ONLY: at z <= 0.105 the directional sightline signal (-0.006 to -0.013 mag under an anisotropic ray-wise extension) has ~0.3-0.4 sigma expected SNR relative to the +- 0.036 mag uncertainty of N = 280 unique Pantheon+ SNe, and low-z void-boundary peculiar velocities (Bolejko et al. 2013, PRL 110, 021302) contribute comparable variance. The -0.052 mag deep z <= 0.70 curve requires an explicit directional extension beyond sky-averaged Eq. (4).
